# StudySenpai

> Clan-based live coding cohorts run by working software engineers and freelancers. Small live batches, senpai code reviews, zero spam calls, and no upfront fees — students pay only after 2 free live demo classes.

## Overview
- **Name**: StudySenpai
- **Website**: https://studysenpai.lovable.app/
- **Tagline**: Education by engineers for future builders.
- **Model**: Live, hands-on "clan" batches (capped seats), not recorded video playlists.
- **Schedule**: Live sessions Monday to Friday between 8:00 PM and 10:00 PM IST (scheduled flexibly based on student availability).
- **Languages**: Available in Tamil and English.
- **Batch Cycle**: New clans launch on the 5th of every month (1st–5th is Clan Formation & Transition).
- **Pricing**: ₹0 upfront. Pay ₹499 only after attending 2 free live demo sessions.
- **Placement Support**: Final class dedicated to ATS-cracking resume building, portfolio curation, and tech interview preparation.
- **Placement Policy**: Transparent disclaimer — no fake placement guarantees; real engineering merit and interview prep.
- **Communication Policy**: WhatsApp and Telegram only. Zero cold calls.
- **Credentials**: Blockchain-verified, tamper-proof certificates verifiable via direct QR scan.

## Foundation Roadmap (₹499 per 1-month phase)
- **Phase 1 — Web Fundamentals**: HTML5, Modern CSS, JavaScript ES6+, DOM Manipulation. Zero experience required.
- **Phase 2 — Modern Frontend & BaaS**: React.js, State Management, Firebase Auth & Cloud Firestore.
- **Phase 3 — Backend & Database Mastery**: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, REST APIs, Authentication & Security.

## Advanced Tracks (₹499 per phase)
- **Track A — Web3 & Blockchain Engineering**: Solidity, Smart Contracts, Hardhat, Contract Deployment, Testnets, ERC Tokens, OpenZeppelin.
- **Track B — Generative AI & Autonomous Systems**: RAG Frameworks, LLM Application Building, Local LLMs, Cloud LLMs, Agentic Tools (OpenClaw).

## Flagship 6-Month Cohorts (Coming Soon)
- 6-Month Full Stack MERN Clan
- 6-Month Gen AI Full Stack Clan
- 6-Month Web3 Full Stack Clan

Students can reserve seats via the admission form on the homepage: https://studysenpai.lovable.app/#join
